summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only review PASSED. All 5 targeted flows verified on mobile viewport (390x844) as demo@sandgarage.app: (1) Tapping code-row-P0171 in Diagnostics navigates to /code/P0171 (NOT to the car). (2) /code/P0171 renders code-detail-screen with code-hero (severity-coloured WARNING yellow border, big tabular code text, description 'System Too Lean (Bank 1)', system 'Engine'), occurrences-list with 2 occurrence rows (occurrence-{diag_id}) and the OCCURRENCES counter shows '2' exactly matching the list length. (3) Tapping an occurrence navigates to /car/{car_id} and car-detail-screen renders. (4) From Car Detail, tapping code-chip-P0171 navigates to /code/P0171. (5) /code/ZZZ9999 (unknown code) gracefully renders empty-occurrences state with text 'No occurrences found for this code.' and 0 occurrence rows. (6) Existing flows still work — login, garage list, car detail with multi-photo gallery and EXPORT chip; clicking export-pdf-button on web triggers Linking.openURL (observed window.open invoked with /api/cars/{id}/diagnostics/export?token=JWT URL) without any pageerror or red screen. Backend tests skipped per request (frontend-only).
action_items: Non-blocking expo-router console warning: "Route '/[code]' with param 'code' was specified both in the path and as a param, removing from path" fires when pushing to /code/${code}. The route still works correctly (URL becomes /code/P0171?code=P0171 and the screen reads code from useLocalSearchParams). Cosmetic only. Optional fix: push({ pathname: '/code/[code]', params: { code } }) or push(`/code/${code}`) without the param object (current code already uses the latter, so this is an expo-router quirk). Safe to ignore.
Non-blocking RN-web warning seen repeatedly: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (originates from LinearGradient overlay in car/[id].tsx heroOverlay). Cosmetic only.
Optional: expo-image style.resizeMode deprecation warning printed once when entering car detail with gallery — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: app/code/[code].tsx correctly does an exact-case-insensitive filter (it.code.toUpperCase() === code.toUpperCase()) so P0171 won't match P0171X — verified visually with 2 occurrences (no leakage).
useFocusEffect + setLoading(true) before load() pattern is correct so revisiting the screen re-fetches.
Empty state in code/[code].tsx is wired via FlatList ListEmptyComponent with testID='empty-occurrences' — works perfectly for ZZZ9999.
car/[id].tsx code chips correctly wrapped in Pressable with testID='code-chip-{code}' and router.push(`/code/${tc.code}`) — verified navigates as expected.
exportPdf() web branch calls Linking.openURL(url) which on RN-web maps to window.open — verified 1 window.open call with correct signed URL, no pageerror, screen stays mounted.
API_BASE token is appended via encodeURIComponent — good.
